plotEn:
In a direct-to-camera introduction, Ali G recounts the heights of his success with Da Ali G Show, his destitution after its cancellation, and relocating back to Staines-upon-Thames. When he discovers that his long-term girlfriend Julie is pregnant, he unsuccessfully attempts to gain employment and later resorts to pawning his old items, where he discovers a 2004 fax from HBO offering him $3.2 million to appear in a third series of Da Ali G Show. Ali and Julie arrive in America, where Ali consumes a lavish brunch with the production crew of his new show until it is discovered that the offer from HBO was 22 years out-of-date and thus has expired. He nevertheless resolves to press ahead with production of his show and to instead self-publish it on TikTok. Ali secures sponsorship from a nutrition company and livestreams interviews combined with 2020s trends — including ASMR with an army general, a mukbang with Allan Lichtman, and a clothes haul with Arthur B. McDonald.
Meanwhile, news of Ali's return reaches lecturer Nira Cain-N'Degeocello, who complains Ali is engaging in cultural appropriation. Nira takes to an Oakland community center in attempts to convince the attendees to take a stand against Ali, to which they respond with indifference and mockery. Nira confronts Ali via livestream, promising to seek his destruction due to his politically incorrect rhetoric.
